batchConverter.description: Convert folders of FB2 and supported e-book formats in batch

export.settingsDialogNote: Changes here are saved for Batch Converter only and do not change Settings -> Exports.

import.noneSelected: Select at least one import format to convert.

ocr.useOcr: Use OCR for scanned or image-based PDFs
ocr.noLanguages: Select at least one installed OCR language for PDF OCR.
ocr.disabledNote: Enable PDF in Formats to convert to configure PDF OCR.

paths.inPlace: In-place conversion (save output beside each input file)

options.zipEpubNote: EPUB files are already ZIP archives
options.fixBroken: Fix broken XML in memory (do not modify source files)

validation.missingDestination: Choose a destination folder or enable in-place conversion.
validation.noImportFormat: Select at least one import format.
validation.noOcrLanguage: Select at least one installed OCR language or uncheck Use OCR.

report.emptyMessage: No convertible files matching your selection were found in the source folder.
report.noIssues: All files converted cleanly with no failures, skips, or repairs.

reportFile.title: Maxima Fiction Book Editor — Batch Conversion Report
reportFile.outputInPlace: In-place beside input files (ZIP output: {{zip}}; Overwrite: {{overwrite}})

reasons.targetBusy: Target output file is currently being written by another worker.
reasons.targetIsSource: Output path is the same as the input file.
reasons.targetIsOpenBook: Output path matches the book currently open in the editor.
reasons.sourceNotDirectory: Source path is not a folder.
reasons.sourceUnreadable: Source folder could not be read.
reasons.extractFailed: Could not extract file from ZIP archive.
reasons.archiveTooLarge: Archive entry exceeds size safety limits.
reasons.archiveMethod: Archive uses an unsupported compression method.
reasons.encryptedMobi: Encrypted or DRM-protected MOBI files are not supported.
reasons.encodingFailed: Could not determine a readable text encoding.
reasons.unreadableFbd: Companion FBD could not be read and was skipped: {{detail}}
reasons.brokenXmlFixed: Broken XML repaired in memory (line {{line}}, column {{column}}): {{message}}
reasons.brokenXmlSkipped: Broken XML skipped because Fix broken is off (line {{line}}, column {{column}}): {{message}}
reasons.brokenXmlSkippedGeneric: Broken XML skipped because Fix broken is off: {{message}}

tips.tabFromFb2: Convert FB2 books to another supported e-book format
tips.tabToFb2: Convert other supported e-book formats to FB2
tips.targetFormat: Format to convert FB2 books into (starts from Settings -> Exports defaults)
tips.exportSettings: Adjust export options for Batch Converter (saved separately from global Settings)
tips.exportSettingsEpub: EPUB has no format-specific export settings
tips.fixBroken: Repair broken FB2 XML in memory before conversion and log it as Fixed without modifying source files; when unchecked, broken XML files are skipped
tips.importAll: Convert every supported import format found in the source folder
tips.importFormat: Include {{format}} files when importing to FB2
tips.sourceDir: Folder containing the source books to convert
tips.includeSubfolders: Scan nested subfolders inside the source folder
tips.inPlace: Save each converted file next to its source file instead of a destination folder
tips.destinationDir: Folder where converted files will be written
tips.keepTree: Recreate the source subfolder hierarchy inside the destination folder
tips.zipOutput: Package each converted output inside a ZIP archive
tips.overwrite: Replace existing output files instead of skipping them
tips.parallel: Convert multiple books at once using background threads (up to cores minus 1)
tips.workerCount: Maximum number of files converted at the same time (up to cores minus 1)
tips.start: Start scanning and converting matching books
tips.cancel: Stop scheduling new files and abort active conversions
tips.saveReport: Save a UTF-8 report with failures, skips, repaired files, and per-book warnings
tips.filterAll: Show failed, skipped, and fixed entries in the report list
tips.filterFailed: Show only failed entries in the report list
tips.filterSkipped: Show only skipped entries in the report list
tips.filterFixed: Show only repaired (fixed in memory) entries in the report list
tips.filterOcr: Show only files where offline PDF OCR ran
tips.pdfUseOcr: Run offline OCR on scanned or image-based PDF pages during unattended batch conversion
tips.ocrAutoDetect: Automatically detect OCR language within the checked batch languages
tips.ocrLanguages: Installed OCR languages available for this batch run (saved separately from global Settings)
